recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Do not use FHIR-20470 to remove current explicit SearchParameter multiple declarations; review those only under their own later resource-specific Jira issues if they are independently suspected to be incorrect.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking for an R4 technical correction to remove automatically declared AND, OR, modifier, and comparator capabilities from published core SearchParameter instances so base definitions could remain usable for derived or constrained SearchParameters.
initial_application: Commit 50c62d61d20ddacb5f2cfe86a5101bb5dbadaf41, titled "GF#20470 - remove And/or/modifier from generated search parameters," removed the generator's default multipleAnd/multipleOr settings and automatic modifier population for generated SearchParameters. Current built search-parameter bundles do not contain comparator, modifier, or chain declarations.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread and FHIR-I 2019-02-25 minutes show the concern was the all-or-nothing R4 publication of every possible capability. Later issues FHIR-20471 and FHIR-56196 approved capabilitystatement-expectation contexts for SearchParameter capability elements, and FHIR-48481 added derivation guidance explaining how derived SearchParameters interact with declared and undeclared multiple/comparator/modifier values. Remaining current multipleOr/multipleAnd declarations are in Appointment, DeviceAlert, ImagingStudy, and ImagingSelection bundles and trace to later resource-specific work, including FHIR-41397 and FHIR-47526.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Removing the few current explicit multipleAnd/multipleOr declarations under FHIR-20470 would overrule later narrower work-group decisions rather than complete the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: Follow-up mechanism for applying capabilitystatement-expectation to SearchParameter multipleAnd, multipleOr, comparator, modifier, and chain.
